comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Item 0 asks whether any comment has calm, even-toned logical reasoning, so tone matters and reasons or inferences are enough. Item 1 asks whether any comment supplies specific factual data or verifiable citations, so the content must be concrete statistics, dates, links or named sources. A comment can reason logically with no data or citations, and a comment can cite data in an aggressive tone. Both use OC_comments with the same binary and null rules, but the extraction predicates differ.
